sectionHeadings: 031: Qualify and publish the downstream release under distinct package names
B-1. One version, and it says what it is
B-2. The packages are renamed and the libraries are not
B-3. Every manifest says it is not upstream
B-4. Publication is dependency-first, staged, and never `--no-verify`
B-5. The registry token and the review credential never meet
B-6. The tag and the manifests must agree
B-7. The lint matrix compiles the `server` feature
B-8. The qualification graph is committed, and the consumer graph is qualified separately
record.summary: Renames the three packages so nothing resolves under an upstream name, versions them at 0.15.0-patched.1 because the public API changed, keeps the library names and the internal dependency keys so consumers and the feature table need no rewriting, and adds a publication workflow and an independent review workflow with separate triggers and separate credentials. Records the release work ledger, and the acceptance corrections the rename forced.
record.title: Qualify and publish the downstream release under distinct package names
